say:1:1721229001:1.text: Count Ramir! He's the one who sold me the fish! He can prove I'm innocent! Hey, Count Ramir!
say:1:1721229001:1.source_cn: 拉米尔伯爵！是他卖给我那条霓光鲤的，他能证明我的清白！...

narration:2:1721229002:1.text: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.
narration:2:1721229002:1.male: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.
narration:2:1721229002:1.female: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.

choice_prompt:3:1721229002.text: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.
choice_prompt:3:1721229002.source_cn: 看着向拉米尔热情挥手的葛朗台，你与费南队长交换了一个无奈的眼神
choice_prompt:3:1721229002.male: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.
choice_prompt:3:1721229002.female: Watching Grandet wave at Ramir like he's greeting an old friend, you and Captain Fernand trade a tired look.

say:4:1721229003:1.text: W-What do you mean? I'm not sure I follow...
say:4:1721229003:1.source_cn: 什、什么意思？您这话，我有点听不懂……

say:5:1721229004:1.text: Captain Fernand explains everything: the truth about the neon carp, and the fact that Ramir tricked him out of a fortune...
say:5:1721229004:1.source_cn: 费南队长将你们的调查结果告诉了葛朗台。包括霓光鲤的真相...
say:5:1721229004:1.male: Captain Fernand explains everything: the truth about the neon carp, and the fact that Ramir tricked him out of a fortune...
say:5:1721229004:1.female: Captain Fernand explains everything: the truth about the neon carp, and the fact that Ramir tricked him out of a fortune...

say:6:1721229005:1.text: What?! You mean the count and that woman were working together to cheat me?!
say:6:1721229005:1.source_cn: 什么？！你们是说，伯爵大人和那个女人，合起伙来骗我？！
say:6:1721229005:1.male: What?! You mean the count and that woman were working together to cheat me?!
say:6:1721229005:1.female: What?! You mean the count and that woman were working together to cheat me?!

say:7:1721229006:1.text: I paid a million gold for a common fish... then I hired reporters... rented the whole stretch of river... invited half the city to come watch...
say:7:1721229006:1.source_cn: 我花了一百万买了条普通的鱼，还请了一大堆媒体宣传……花...

say:8:1721229007:1.text: So what you're telling me is... I personally paid for a crowd to come watch me make a fool of myself?!
say:8:1721229007:1.source_cn: ——这么说，我岂不是特意找了一堆人……来看我自己的笑话？！

say:10:1721229009:1.text: Grandet rolls his eyes so hard he nearly faints.
say:10:1721229009:1.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵气得直翻白眼，差点直接倒在地上。

say:11:1721229010:1.text: Dura above. Leave the poor man alone for a moment.
say:11:1721229010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，先让他一个人静静吧。

choice:3:0:1.text: Save your breath. He's the one who scammed you.
choice:3:0:1.male: Save your breath. He's the one who scammed you.
choice:3:0:1.female: Save your breath. He's the one who scammed you.

choice:3:1:2.text: Honestly, I'm starting to feel a little sorry for you.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 说真的，我有点可怜你了
choice:3:1:2.male: Honestly, I'm starting to feel a little sorry for you.
choice:3:1:2.female: Honestly, I'm starting to feel a little sorry for you.
